result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only visually broken element is the circular button in the top-right corner, whose icon/avatar failed to load, leaving an empty gray circle with a stray red notification dot. Horizontal carousel clipping and the bottom-cut card are expected scroll behavior and were not counted.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner (next to the delivery address) shows only a light gray placeholder circle with a small red notification dot; its icon or avatar content is missing/unrendered, making the control look broken and its purpose unclear.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon or user avatar inside the circle (e.g., bell or profile icon), and verify the image/icon asset loads; keep the red dot as a badge on top of the loaded content.

issues.description: Because the top-right circular button has no visible glyph or label, its function cannot be identified visually, and it likely lacks an accessible name as well.
issues.suggestion: Add a recognizable icon plus an accessibility label (e.g., 'Notifications') so sighted and screen-reader users can understand the control.
